missing_value_policy: Preserve null scores and transitions; compare ablations on the same eligible rows. Do not turn missing coverage into an apparent improvement.
model_fit_policy: Per sensor type on bounded, channel-balanced, past-only train candidate samples. 2019 H1 is warm-up; 2019 H2 and later train years use earlier periods. Validation and test share a model frozen before 2025-01-01.
hdbscan_limitation: Distance to fitted HDBSCAN cluster centroids is an out-of-sample proxy, not exact HDBSCAN membership.
transition_limitation: A transition compares adjacent admitted candidate hours on the same channel within 24 hours under the same fitted model; it does not prove continuous operation.
